name: application-dividers
title: Dividers
description: Responsive layout divider components with basic, gradient, and aligned styles for separating content sections in web applications and UI designs.
useWhen: Responsive layout divider components with basic, gradient, and aligned styles for separating content sections in web applications and UI designs.
avoidWhen: Avoid dividers when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Dividers uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
